==Description==
The '''Vampire''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[Trick or Threat Town]] as part of the [[Halloween 2020 Event]]. For its debut, the '''Vampire''' had low health and had the same speed as [[Mummy (Trick or Threat Town)|Mummy]]. However, upon its death, it transformed into the [[Bat (Trick or Threat Town)|Bat]], which was a very dangerous enemy.

==Appearance==
The '''Vampire''' wore a red tuxedo, complete a yellow-buttoned dark red shirt. It wore a spiky collar and had yellow wrist-bands. It had black pants and its skin was completely white. It had a {{RLinkC|29532363|Vampire}} face and black hair. It floated a short distance above the ground.

==Strategy==
*While the '''Vampire''' has somewhat low health, its main threat is the [[Bat (Trick or Threat Town)|Bat]] it spawns.
**The [[Bat (Trick or Threat Town)|Bat]] is considerably faster than the '''Vampire''', is hidden and can fly, meaning that it cannot be detected by ground towers, [[units]] or towers without hidden detection.
*If a '''Vampire''' has low health and is near the end of the map, try not to kill it, as it will transform into a [[Bat (Trick or Threat Town)|Bat]] and lower your base health considerably more.
*A couple of [[Ranger]]s and [[Minigunner]]s should be placed down prior to the debut of the '''Vampire'''.
**You can use the [[Ace Pilot]], [[Sniper]] or [[Pursuit]] to deal with the [[Bat (Trick or Threat Town)|Bat]] it spawns.
